views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates described Compass Group as the world's largest contract caterer feeding millions daily across workplaces, hospitals, universities and major sporting events, and noted Alphabet was its largest customer yet under 1% of revenue, showing scale and diversified service.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates highlighted Compass as a broad, robust business serving many industries, customers and geographies, reducing exposure to any single customer or sector shock, which aligned with a preference for resilient profit streams.
